landing.heroSubtitle: A premium learning ecosystem for students, parents, and educators — blending structured curriculum with on-demand tutoring.
landing.sectionSubtitle: Everything you need to excel, integrated into one seamless platform.
landing.feature1Body: Structured programs mapped to national educational standards for relevant, effective studying.
landing.feature2Body: 24/7 intelligent tutoring to unblock students instantly.
landing.feature3Body: Connect 1-on-1 with top-rated educators for personalized help.
landing.feature4Body: Deep insight into learning patterns, strengths, and areas needing attention.
landing.highlight2Label: Roles, each with its own dashboard
landing.rolesLead: Parents, students and teachers each get their own view of the same programs — and each one has a boundary the platform enforces, not just a screen it hides.
landing.role_parentTagline: Approves, pays, and keeps an eye on the year.
landing.role_parentCan1: Register a child and approve their account
landing.role_parentCan2: Read report cards, attendance and homework results
landing.role_parentCan3: Message the teacher and manage enrollments
landing.role_parentNote: A student under 18 always resolves to a verified guardian.
landing.role_studentTagline: Learns, submits, and tracks their own progress.
landing.role_studentCan1: Browse the catalog and open enrolled programs
landing.role_studentCan2: Watch lessons, take quizzes and submit homework
landing.role_studentCan3: Follow their progress, grades and points
landing.role_studentNote: Access needs an active account and an approved guardian.
landing.role_teacherTagline: Builds the programs and grades the work.
landing.role_teacherCan1: Author programs, chapters and every lesson type
landing.role_teacherCan2: Grade quizzes, homework and exams in one queue
landing.role_teacherCan3: Message parents about their own students
landing.role_teacherNote: A program goes live only after admin review.
landing.feature5Body: Exam averages, quiz scores and homework rates in one report — and a direct line to the teacher.
landing.feature6Body: Earn points as you learn and spend them on the programs you want next.
landing.footerTagline: A learning platform for Egyptian families — programs, tutoring and progress in one place.
